messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: INC-2026-418 \u00b7 continuous-batcher (rt-pool) p95 latency spike + OOMs on us-west-2. paging triggered. paging_level=critical. paging oncall @maria

maria: acknowledged. what's the readout?

aj: tail latency readout: p50 210ms p95 5.9s p99 12s. error surge -> 502/503, several containers restarted under kube. batch queue depth climbing to thousands for some pods.

kevin: gpu-42 shows constant GPU memory at 99% by monitored process. kubelet logs show repeated cudaErrorMalloc failures and context resets.

linh: grabbing logs. here's a snippet from the continuous-batcher on gpu-42:
```
[2026-04-02T18:16:12Z] batcher: enqueue_count=1872 waterline=256
[2026-04-02T18:16:14Z] runtime: mem alloc failed cudaMalloc returned OUT_OF_MEMORY
[2026-04-02T18:16:14Z] runtime: crashing on oom, stack: runtime::Allocator::alloc
```

maria: initial triage: likely batch growth caused by a mix of long-sequence requests + aggressive prefetch + a recent cuda micro-driver patch on canary nodes. combined with a KV cache leak in runtime image v1.9. suspect kvcache and prefetch interplay.

sre-bot: Node-flap detected (gpu-42): 4 restarts in 6m. Autoscaler moving pods -> gpu-51, gpu-53.

aj: customer-impact: top customers in rt-pool (ai-docs, convo-pro) seeing failures. current error-rate ~27% across region.

maria: mitigation strategy (live): 1) temporarily throttle batcher: set max_inflight_requests=64 for rt-pool 2) disable prefetch flag for rt-pool 3) cap kvcache to 8k items 4) trigger model-fallback to compact-q4 variant on high-mem nodes 5) cordon + drain gpu-42. I'll run sequence now.

kevin: +1. also perform rolling restart of runtime daemonset on nodes with old image tag v1.9 to pick up leak fix.

maria: executing changes:
```
kubectl patch deployment rt-continuous-batcher -n inference --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/MAX_INFLIGHT","value":"64"}]'
featurectl set rt-pool prefetch=false --env=production
kubectl annotate node gpu-42 maintenance=true --overwrite
rdlctl config set rt-pool.kvcache.max_items=8000
rdlctl route set-fallback rt-pool --model redwood-mini-q4
```

linh: prefetch flag propagated. kvcache cap applied. autoscaler reducing replicas from 14 -> 9.

aj: after mitigations p95 down to 1.7s, error rate down to 5.4%. still catching sporadic OOMs on gpu-51 though (some pods still on v1.9 runtime).

kevin: performing restart of daemonset on affected nodes and bumping runtime image to v1.9.1-hotfix. issuing restart now.
```
kubectl rollout restart daemonset/runtime -n inference --selector=region=us-west-2
```

sam: (CS) preparing customer advisory. ETA for full recovery ~25-35m. flagging enterprise customers and opening high-priority support tickets.

linh: after daemonset restart we see GC of KV entries and freed GPU memory. cudaErrorMalloc events drop significantly. batch queue depth stable ~110-160.

maria: good. capture temp guardrails we applied so we can revert: max_inflight=64, prefetch=false, kvcache cap=8000, fallback active. will create followups.

aj: immediate followups to action post-incident: 1) auto-fallback rule when node_gpu_mem_util > 88% 2) integrate a synthetic load test that exercises long-context + prefetch to detect batch growth regressions 3) add alert for continuous-batcher queue growth beyond 500 for >2m 4) revert risky cuda micro-patch from canary fleet if correlation confirmed.

kevin: I'll own runtime leak fix patch and backport to stable. estimate 36-48h. will open PR and link here.

maria: note for PMs: evaluate prefetch as opt-in for high-memory models vs default-on. long-term we might need better per-request memory accounting and kvcache admission control.

ops-bot: incident INC-2026-418 status -> mitigated (partial). runbook snapshot saved to /incidents/INC-2026-418/snapshots/runbook-1769876543.txt

maria: handing off to night oncall @tess in 25m. current status: recovering but still degraded; mitigations applied; watch for re-escalation. handoff summary pinned to incident page.

tess: ack. reading thread. will monitor dashboards (p95, error-rate, node restarts) and escalate to dedicated capacity if we see new spike. please page me if errors >10% again.

sam: customer update sent to impacted tenants (IDs: C112233, C445566). no SLA breaches detected yet; tracking closely.

maria: timeline notes: alert at 1769876543, peak errors at 1769876589, mitigations started 1769876608, p95 stabilized 1769876760. creating a blameless postmortem ticket and linking followups: rdl/serving#802 (prefetch), rdl/infra#1430 (kvcache), rdl/runtime#325 (leak), rdl/ops#98 (cuda-patch-rollbacks).

aj: thanks all. nice coordination. :thumbsup:

maria: closing Slack thread; moving investigations and long-term action items to github. keep monitoring until incident fully resolved.

ops-bot: NOTE: snapshot of metrics and config saved to /incidents/INC-2026-418/artifacts/metrics-1769876543.tar.gz
